negative_controls.valid_actual_model_caveat: shared-shock uses deterministic known-range reference, not stochastic graph concentration; proper missing-clipping-bias certificate is vacuous width1

paper_ready_english_paragraphs: Across 1,600 supplementary anchor logs, all 68 eligible primary cell-method comparisons covered their complete target family in 200/200 independent trials, with no observed false claim or Holm undercoverage flag. The homogeneous IID anchor has one target coordinate; the heterogeneous cycle scaling anchors have 16. In the bounded IID setting, the independent DR empirical-Bernstein comparator produced a mean intersected width of 0.01055, compared with 0.01748 for COMET, its matched generic version and graph Bernstein; all detected the violation in 200/200 trials. In the heavy-tailed IID setting, the Catoni anchor was narrower than COMET (0.15246 versus 0.17416), but both detected no violation. One scalar-betting interval missed the target at the secondary 90% level (199/200 coverage); its primary 95% coverage was 200/200. The runner marked that log COMPLETE_WITH_CONFIDENCE_FAILURE; the completed analysis reports no execution failure.

With N=8,192, 32,768 and 131,072, COMET’s mean intersected coordinate widths were 0.03424, 0.01666 and 0.00821 in the bounded cycle model, and 0.19071, 0.12153 and 0.07664 in the heavy-tailed model. Every applicable method detected a violation in 200/200 bounded trials and 0/200 heavy-tailed trials at each sample size. These are descriptive results for fixed data-generating processes, rather than a minimax-rate validation; methods and confidence levels share each complete log.

Four prespecified invalid-assumption controls used 25 complete logs each and a fixed threshold of 0.6. The deliberately invalid, heuristic intervals made false-safe claims in 25/25 trials under wrong propensities, evaluation-nuisance leakage and omission of clipping bias, and false-violation claims in 13/25 trials under a hidden shared shock; all four heuristic arms had 0/25 interval coverage. The correctly declared range reference for the shared shock and the bias-debited clipping certificate each covered 25/25 targets but had width one and no violation detection. Truthfully disclosed unsupported requests were refused in 25/25 trials per control: their coverage and error rates are not applicable. These diagnostics neither certify the invalid arms nor imply that input schemas can discover hidden dependence or nuisance leakage.
uncertainty: Saved source Wilson95 per fixed cell/method/level over complete independent logs; not simultaneous, not candidate pooling. Copied stored server values without local floating-point recomputation.
